name: Anantara Convento di Amalfi Grand Hotel
positioning: A converted 13th-century Capuchin convent built into the cliffside above Amalfi's harbour, with sea-view rooms that were once monks' quarters
best_for: Travelers who want a historic convent setting with sea views
Couples looking for suites with private terraces and cloister or lemon-grove settings
Guests who want to walk into Amalfi town

facts.text: The hotel was originally a 13th-century Capuchin convent built into the cliffside.
It overlooks the harbour, 600 metres from the Amalfi town centre.
The hotel sits 80 metres above the sea, with views over Amalfi and the Gulf of Salerno.
The convent became a hotel in 1882.
The rooms were originally the monks' quarters.
Almost all rooms and suites look directly out to sea.
A long loggia laden with bougainvillea, the Passeggiata dei Monaci, runs along the terraces.
A twelfth-century chapel on site is used for weddings.
The swimming pool and a panoramic gym with Technogym equipment are on the cliffside, and there is an Anantara Spa.
Hotel experiences include breathwork and sound healing in the convent.
There are two restaurants: Dei Cappuccini, the main restaurant, and La Locanda della Canonica, for an informal outdoor lunch.
Chef Claudio Lanuto uses seasonal ingredients grown in the convent garden.

highlights.text: The heated infinity pool is available all season.
Suites offer options such as a private terrace with a jacuzzi, views of the cloisters, or a standalone suite in the lemon grove.
Behind the monastery-hermitage is part of the old Arab-Norman cloister, colonnaded with interlaced arches.
The hotel works with a Franciscan friar from Ravello who introduces guests to the chapel or takes them on tours of Ravello.
Guests have access to the Lido degli Artisti beach club, five minutes away by boat.

considerations.text: The hotel is on the cliffside rather than on the beach; the Lido degli Artisti beach club is reached by boat and charges apply.
The historic building has many steps in different directions, though lifts reach every level.
The hotel is a one-and-a-half-hour drive from Naples International Airport, and valet parking carries a daily charge.
